highlights: Designed and delivered three production products in under a year — a fleet SaaS dashboard, a cross-platform mobile app (Android & iOS), and an ERP frontend — solely owning architecture, UI consistency, and deployment from scratch.

Built an agentic AI development workflow using a 7-agent orchestration pipeline that cut ERP module delivery from days of manual coding to 10-20 minutes, generating 5000+ lines of production-ready code per run.

Designed a 4-layer shared architecture across 13 ERP modules so each new module could be added without touching existing code, with reusable UI primitives reducing the effort needed to build each new screen significantly.
Automated procurement and sales document workflows entirely in the frontend, replacing a manual multi-step process and enabling users to complete the full approval cycle without leaving the app.

Automated vehicle document tracking by integrating directly with the RTO RC Department, eliminating manual data entry for operators and enabling bulk vehicle onboarding that previously required individual lookups.
Built a renewal scheduling system with user-defined dynamic columns, giving ops teams the ability to configure their own tracking workflows without engineering involvement.
Ran structured code reviews for a two-person team, enforcing consistent patterns and catching issues before they reached production.
Shipped 40+ Figma designs as production-ready screens with pixel-accurate layouts and responsive behaviour, completing the full frontend in six weeks.
Structured the component library from scratch so every page shared a unified visual language, eliminating inconsistency across the product.
